non_goals: Do not modify haos_core public APIs.
Do not tune thresholds after seeing outcomes.
Do not add fields merely because they separate the target.
Do not promote CST to an authoritative phase.
Do not add physics, consciousness, or ontology claims.

coarse_signature_id.source: stable hash of compact address summary

equivalence.rule: equivalent(A,B) iff all required available component distances satisfy strict tolerances

invariant_summary.semantic_justification: Closure recovery should preserve coarse invariant descriptors under matched perturbation.
invariant_summary.extraction_method: copy normalized Phase 15 transport descriptors and Phase 18 shell-order score.
invariant_summary.normalization: bounded relative component distances at comparison time

structural_graph_summary.semantic_justification: Closure domains are represented by recovered event-transition and influence-edge organization.
structural_graph_summary.extraction_method: derive transition edges from chain_signature and copy frozen edge-count summaries.
structural_graph_summary.normalization: edge-set Jaccard plus bounded count drift

spectral_summary.semantic_justification: Low-mode descriptors are part of the current closure observable surface.
spectral_summary.extraction_method: copy low-mode fraction, low-mode power, and terminal fluctuation slope.
spectral_summary.normalization: bounded relative component distances at comparison time

causal_summary.semantic_justification: Closure stability should preserve influence ordering, causal depth, and mismatch structure.
causal_summary.extraction_method: copy causal depth, acyclicity, cycle, order-compatibility, and mismatch summaries.
causal_summary.normalization: front-depth fixed scale plus bounded relative causal-field distances

temporal_sequence_summary.semantic_justification: Closure recoverability includes event ordering and recovered timing relations.
temporal_sequence_summary.extraction_method: record chain_signature, transitions, available event times, and timing-source quality.
temporal_sequence_summary.normalization: rank distance plus tau-grid event-time distance; directly observed timing mode is separately auditable

shell_distance_surrogate_summary.semantic_justification: Shell-order and distance-surrogate fields are the repository-native closure-distance observables.
shell_distance_surrogate_summary.extraction_method: copy shell-ordering metrics and per-shell distance-surrogate rows.
shell_distance_surrogate_summary.normalization: reported raw; selected fields contribute through component distances

stable_address_summary.semantic_justification: Address fields provide a compact recovery address but do not alone define identity.
stable_address_summary.extraction_method: copy dominant prefix, front depth profile, shell monotonicity, and compatibility band.
stable_address_summary.normalization: address prefix/depth distance with explicit floor audit

provenance_metadata.semantic_justification: Provenance must remain inspectable but cannot define closure identity.
provenance_metadata.source_artifact: CST observation metadata and source artifact hashes

phase_2_2_invariant_control.control_purpose: Preserve labels and marginal descriptor values while destroying invariant field relationships.
phase_2_2_invariant_control.invalidation_condition: Invalid if d_inv does not increase by the predeclared minimum or expected unaffected metrics shift beyond tolerance.
phase_2_2_invariant_control.implementation_provenance: deterministic field rotation within invariant_summary; no source artifacts modified

phase_2_2_structural_control.control_purpose: Preserve node and edge counts while destroying recovered transition topology.
phase_2_2_structural_control.invalidation_condition: Invalid if d_struct does not increase or invariant/spectral/causal metrics shift substantially.
phase_2_2_structural_control.implementation_provenance: deterministic chain rotation preserving event multiset and count

phase_2_2_spectral_control.control_purpose: Preserve graph size and density while destroying low-mode alignment.
phase_2_2_spectral_control.invalidation_condition: Invalid if d_spec does not increase or non-spectral components shift substantially.
phase_2_2_spectral_control.implementation_provenance: deterministic low-mode complement transform inside spectral_low_mode_summary only

phase_2_2_causal_control.control_purpose: Preserve event counts and label frequencies while destroying influence ordering and causal dependencies.
phase_2_2_causal_control.invalidation_condition: Invalid if d_causal does not increase or non-causal metrics shift substantially.
phase_2_2_causal_control.implementation_provenance: deterministic causal-depth and compatibility perturbation inside causal_summary

phase_2_2_temporal_control.control_purpose: Preserve event-time marginals and counts while destroying sequence and transition structure.
phase_2_2_temporal_control.invalidation_condition: Invalid if temporal ordering survives or invariant/spectral summaries shift substantially.
phase_2_2_temporal_control.implementation_provenance: deterministic sequence reversal with original event-time multiset retained

phase_2_2_address_control.control_purpose: Preserve coarse spectral summaries while destroying stable address correspondence.
phase_2_2_address_control.invalidation_condition: Invalid if d_addr does not increase or spectral/invariant/temporal summaries shift substantially.
phase_2_2_address_control.implementation_provenance: deterministic address-summary prefix rotation; source artifacts unchanged

perturbation_free_baseline.control_purpose: Use a matched unperturbed frozen run if available.
perturbation_free_baseline.invalidation_condition: Unavailable unless a valid frozen matched unperturbed artifact exists.

instrument_discriminative_requires: required destructive controls move intended metrics
expected unaffected metrics remain within tolerance
fine signatures have no unexplained structural collisions
target_distinct_requires: target-focus-control strict equivalence fails for all focus controls
component separation rejects H0 under predeclared controls
verdict_logic.strict_hash_policy: No hash equality may imply equivalence.
